title: ci(release): move stale pre-release dist-tags up to latest after a stable publish
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D2u97USsjrQQKUiupKtvnSj)_

Fixes #25581

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

After a stable publish, every pre-release npm dist-tag of the fixed group that the release has overtaken now moves up to the released version.

- **`scripts/release-dist-tags.mjs`** (new). For each non-private workspace package (the same `listWorkspacePackages` derivation `release-verify-npm.mjs` and `release-github-releases.mjs` use), it reads the dist-tags from the registry and, against a REFERENCE version:
  - a tag other than `latest` whose version is a semver **pre-release below** the reference is moved to the reference (`npm dist-tag add NAME@REFERENCE TAG`);
  - a pre-release tag **at or above** the reference is a cycle in progress and is kept;
  - a tag on a **stable** version (a maintenance line) and a non-semver value are left alone; `latest` is never written.
  - REFERENCE is `RELEASE_VERSION` in CI (and then a package whose registry `latest` is not that version is re-read on a bounded 65 s schedule, then skipped with a warning, so no tag can be moved below `latest`); run by hand without it, each package's own `latest`.
  - A pre-release `RELEASE_VERSION` is a no-op (exit 0). An empty package set is refused. Default mode is a read-only plan; `--apply` writes.
  - Every failure (unreadable registry, refused write, `latest` disagreeing) prints one `::warning::` naming the package and makes the exit code 1; the other packages are still processed.
- **`.github/workflows/release.yml`** — one new step, **last in the `publish` job**, after "Publish to npm + push version tags" and the two GitHub Release steps: `if: !cancelled() && steps.publish.outputs.published == 'true'`, `continue-on-error: true`, `timeout-minutes: 15`, `RELEASE_VERSION` from `steps.guards.outputs.version`, and no secret of its own: its credential is the `$HOME/.npmrc` the publish step already wrote from `NPM_TOKEN`. Nothing above it changed: the trigger, `environment: release`, the `publish-pending` predicate and `force` are untouched.
- **`.github/workflows/lint.yml`** — `node scripts/release-dist-tags.mjs --self-test` in `lint-ci-engine`, beside the post-publish npm verification self-test.

## Why non-blocking

npm already holds the whole group when this step runs; a stale tag is a nuisance, never a reason to withhold the GitHub Releases or the runtime image (`docker` needs `publish` to succeed). So the release keeps going and the step's own outcome plus its `::warning::` lines say the sweep was incomplete.

## Self-test

`node scripts/release-dist-tags.mjs --self-test`: 45 cases in 6 batteries, pinned by name with a floor and a verdict handshake (AGENTS.md, "Writing a `--self-test`"):

1. the plan (the card's measured `{"rc":"17.0.0-rc.6","latest":"18.0.0","next":"18.0.0-next.5"}` moves both; a tag ahead of latest is kept; stable and non-semver tags untouched);
2. the reference (pre-release and non-semver `RELEASE_VERSION`; a lagging `latest` re-read until it agrees; one that never agrees moves nothing, after exactly the settle schedule);
3. plan mode writes nothing, `--apply` writes exactly the plan;
4. failures named and counted without stopping the rest; empty set refused;
5. end to end: the real script spawned over a throwaway workspace, a stub registry and a stub `npm` on PATH, asserting the exact `npm dist-tag add` argv;
6. the release.yml wiring, read from the file: the step sits after the publish step, is `continue-on-error`, gated on `published == 'true'`, bounded, runs `--apply` with the guarded version, and carries no `secrets.` reference.

The self-test was seen red before green: its first run failed battery 5 (a synchronous spawn blocked the in-process stub registry), fixed by an async spawn.

## The one-time cleanup (card item 2)

The next stable publish sweeps the current stale tags by itself. To sweep them now, someone holding npm publish rights for `@objectstack` runs, from a checkout of `main` after this lands (`pnpm install` done):

```bash
node scripts/release-dist-tags.mjs           # read-only plan
node scripts/release-dist-tags.mjs --apply   # perform it (uses your npm login)
```

The read-only plan, run from this branch against the live registry: 73 packages, **141 tags would move** (`next` 18.0.0-next.5 and `rc` 17.0.0-rc.6 to 18.1.0), 0 kept, 0 skipped, 0 failures. If your npm account asks for a one-time password on every write, waiting for the next stable release is the easier path. ⛔ Not run by any agent with any token. Deliberately no new `workflow_dispatch` input: release.yml's two dispatch lanes are the publish repair lane and the version-PR refresh, and a third lane in that file is a maintenance cost the header argues against.

## Gates

Local, at head `336c844c` (the branch is on `main` `b2909fd4`):

- all **59** families `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives for this diff exit 0; `--ran` reconciles 59 derived, 59 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero: every row carries its exit code). They include `check-self-test-wired`, `check-self-test-workflow-commands`, `check-ci-filter-parity`, `check-aggregator-roster`, `check-step-collectors`, `check:workflow-step-name-quoting`, `check:required-contexts`, `check:entry-guard`, `check:nul-bytes`, and the `release-verify-npm` and `release-dist-tags` self-tests;
- `eslint --no-inline-config scripts/release-dist-tags.mjs`: exit 0.

The repo-wide farm is CI's; its check-runs on this PR are the verdict for everything outside that list.

## Acceptance notes

- Moved, not removed, as the card prefers: `@next` keeps resolving and never below `@latest`.
- The rule treats a tag on a stable version as out of scope even when it is below latest (for example a future `v17` maintenance tag); only pre-release tags are swept.
- `skip-changeset`: the diff ships nothing from any published package (`scripts/` and two workflows).

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**：稳定版发布成功后，`publish` 作业最后多一步：把 `next`、`rc` 等落后于新 `latest` 的预发布 dist-tag 全部挪到新版本；领先于 `latest` 的（正在进行的预发布周期）和指向稳定版的标签不动；预发布版本的发布不做任何事。逻辑在新脚本 `scripts/release-dist-tags.mjs`，带自测，lint 里跑自测。

**为什么改**：现在 npm 上 73 个包都是 `next`=18.0.0-next.5、`rc`=17.0.0-rc.6，而 `latest` 已是 18.1.0。用户或 AI 习惯性 `npx create-objectstack@next` 会装到比正式版还旧的预发布版，缺正式版的全部修复，且无任何提示；每个以正式版收尾的预发布周期都会重演。

**风险与代价（含回滚）**：该步骤在发布之后、不触碰「ONLY A HUMAN PUBLISHES」那套门控（触发、release 环境审批、publish-pending 判定都未改），不发布任何版本、只改标签，且只会把标签挪到当前 `latest`。失败只告警不让发布失败。最坏情况是标签没挪成，和今天一样。回滚：删掉这一步即可；已挪的标签可用 `npm dist-tag add` 手动改回。

**席位意见**：

**你要做的**：① 本 PR 动了 `.github/workflows/release.yml`（Tier H），需要 GOVERNED_APPROVERS 账户批准一次，之后由席位落地。② 一次性清理（可选，下次正式发版会自动清）：合并后在 main 检出里、用你的 npm 登录运行 `node scripts/release-dist-tags.mjs` 看计划，再 `node scripts/release-dist-tags.mjs --apply` 执行。
